records.intensifyDes: Whenever you consume 6 Cost in total by using cards, increase all allies' ATK by 1%.

records.name: PMD·Overflow
records.des: Whenever using a card, gain 0.1 Cost.
records.intensifyDes: Whenever using a card, gain 0.2 Cost.

records.name: PMD·Burst
records.des: For each [Ascent] you have, gain 0.02 Cost per second.
records.intensifyDes: For each [Ascent] you have, gain 0.03 Cost per second.

records.name: PMD·Gush
records.des: Whenever allies inflict [Interrupt], [Stun], [Knockback], [Launch], [Ricochet], [Break], [Slash], [Rend], [Scorch], [Corrupt] or [Injure], gain 0.05 Cost.
records.intensifyDes: Whenever allies inflict [Interrupt], [Stun], [Knockback], [Launch], [Ricochet], [Break], [Slash], [Rend], [Scorch], [Corrupt] or [Injure], gain 0.1 Cost.

records.name: PMD·Trace
records.des: Increase hand size by 1, and draw 1 card at the start of battle.
records.intensifyDes: Increase hand size by 2, and draw 2 cards at the start of battle.

records.name: PMD·Wave
records.des: Consume all Cost at the start of battle. For every 1 Cost consumed, increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 2%.
records.intensifyDes: Consume all Cost at the start of battle. For every 1 Cost consumed, increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 3%.

records.name: PMD·Tide
records.des: For every 1 Cost you have, increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 2%.
records.intensifyDes: For every 1 Cost you have, increase all allies' Final DMG dealt by 3%.

records.name: PMD·Overrun
records.des: When using a [Leader Skill], gain 0.5 Cost.
records.intensifyDes: When using a [Leader Skill], gain 1 Cost.
